english: A parallelepiped has the origin $O$ as a vertex, and $A(2,1,-1)$, $B(1,3,2)$ and $C$ are the three vertices of the parallelepiped joined to $O$ by edges. The vertex of the parallelepiped opposite to $O$ is $G(\lambda+3,\,2,\,4)$, where $\lambda$ is a real number. The volume of the parallelepiped is $15$, and the vectors $\overrightarrow{OA}$, $\overrightarrow{OB}$, $\overrightarrow{OC}$, in this order, form a right-handed system. Then the value of $\lambda$ is ______.
hindi: एक समान्तर षट्फलक का एक शीर्ष मूलबिन्दु $O$ है, तथा $A(2,1,-1)$, $B(1,3,2)$ और $C$ इसके वे तीन शीर्ष हैं जो $O$ से कोरों द्वारा जुड़े हैं। $O$ के सम्मुख शीर्ष $G(\lambda+3,\,2,\,4)$ है, जहाँ $\lambda$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है। समान्तर षट्फलक का आयतन $15$ है, तथा सदिश $\overrightarrow{OA}$, $\overrightarrow{OB}$, $\overrightarrow{OC}$ इसी क्रम में एक दक्षिणावर्ती (right-handed) निकाय बनाते हैं। तब $\lambda$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Right-handed $\Rightarrow$ the box product is positive and equals the volume: $25+5\lambda=15\Rightarrow\lambda=-2$
($\lambda=-8$ gives $-15$, a left-handed system, so it is rejected)
solution_full: For a parallelepiped with coterminous edges $\overrightarrow{OA}$, $\overrightarrow{OB}$, $\overrightarrow{OC}$, the vertex opposite to $O$ is given by $\overrightarrow{OG}=\overrightarrow{OA}+\overrightarrow{OB}+\overrightarrow{OC}$.

The volume is $\left|[\overrightarrow{OA}\ \overrightarrow{OB}\ \overrightarrow{OC}]\right|$, and the system $\overrightarrow{OA},\overrightarrow{OB},\overrightarrow{OC}$ is right-handed exactly when $[\overrightarrow{OA}\ \overrightarrow{OB}\ \overrightarrow{OC}]>0$.
Right-handed needs $25+5\lambda>0$, so $\lambda=-2$ (then $C=(-2,-2,3)$ and the box product is $15$).
originality_note: New: the third edge is hidden in the opposite vertex G = A + B + C, and the sign of the box product (right-handed orientation) chooses between the two parameter values that give the volume (way 5). Closest known: unknown parameter in an edge vector fixed by a given volume. Different because: the edge must first be recovered from the diagonal vertex and the orientation condition, not the volume, makes the answer unique.

concept_use.Questions based on parallelopiped: The vertex opposite to O is A + B + C, which gives the third coterminous edge OC = (lambda, -2, 3).
concept_use.Application of Scalar triple product: Volume as the absolute value of the box product, and right-handedness as its positive sign, selecting lambda = -2.

stem_review: Read as a student: every vertex, vector and parameter is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Both values with volume 15 are -2 and -8; the right-handed condition leaves only -2, so the answer is unique. Changed: no change.
key_step: Recovering OC from the opposite vertex, then using the sign of the scalar triple product.
justification: Routine chain (vertex relation, 3 x 3 determinant, orientation sign); every step is standard. Above the one-move triple-product question 2024-P1-Q12 (L1) because of the extra vertex and sign steps; like 2026-P2-Q1 (L2).
